summary: Procure 25 Amplitude Advanced seats for Product Analytics pilot (SSO + SCIM)
description:
Request summary:
- Request: Purchase and provision 25 Amplitude Advanced seats for a 6-month pilot run by Product Analytics and Growth. Seats must include SSO (SAML/Okta) and SCIM provisioning, with audit logging enabled and enterprise data retention controls.

Impact / Business justification:
- Product Analytics needs a short-term, centralized workspace to validate behavioral segmentation and experiment analytics prior to a larger investment. A consolidated Amplitude pilot will allow cross-functional teams to validate instrumentation, funnel metrics, and feature flags in a controlled project space.

Requirements:
- 25 Amplitude Advanced seats (immediate provisioning for 20 users, 5 reserved for rotation).
- SSO via Okta SAML + SCIM provisioning (group-based sync).
- Data residency: US (no EU-hosted datasets).
- Audit logs exported to our SIEM (Splunk/Grafana destination) or vendor-hosted audit retention of 12 months.
- Contract term: 6-month pilot; vendor to provide pro-rated pricing or trial credits if available.

Cost center / Billing:
- Primary charge to: ENG-PLAT-ANALYTICS (cost center: 4102).
- Estimated cost: USD 7,500 for 6 months (vendor quote pending final negotiation).

Security / Compliance checks required:
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (SSQ) or SOC2 report on file.
- Confirmation that SCIM will only provision name/email/group metadata and not sensitive PII.

Acceptance criteria:
- SCIM provisioning successfully provisions 20 of 25 seats from Okta test group within 48 hours of contract execution.
- SSO login verified for sample users in two teams.
- Sample dashboards for growth funnel recreated by Analytics within 10 business days.
- Finance and Security approvals recorded in ticket.

Next steps / Requested actions:
1) Procurement/Finance: Request a vendor quote and confirm any available pilot credits; confirm payment method and PO flow.
2) IT/Identity: Pre-approve Okta app configuration and provide required metadata (ACS, EntityID, cert).
3) Security: Validate SSQ or SOC report and confirm SCIM attribute whitelist.
4) Procurement: Draft short-term contract (6 months) with auto-expiry unless extended by product.

Notes:
- Product owner: Lina Torres (Growth).
- Pilot start target: 2026-04-01.
